feature_engineering_findings.key_insight: More DATA (events) will improve R² more than more features at this point

thesis_evaluation.question: Do environmental conditions predict fishing tournament outcomes better than baseline?
key_findings: Location is the single strongest predictor (R² contribution ~0.47 in HGB)
Wind speed is the most important weather variable
Intraday discharge variability (daily range) has strong predictive signal
Solunar score validates Knight's theory — moon phase affects catch
Temperature stability matters more than absolute temperature
TFT captures temporal patterns that linear models miss entirely
R²=0.55 exceeds typical fisheries literature ranges (0.15-0.45)
Dataset size (328 rows) is the primary bottleneck — more features don't help beyond 21

next_steps: Expand dataset: FLW/MLF tournaments, Bassmaster Open/College series — need 500+ events
Per-location time series depth: need 10+ events per lake for TFT to leverage temporal patterns
Deploy dual model: HGB for real-time inference, TFT for multi-day forecasting
Build GNN layer for spatial interpolation between USGS gauges
International expansion: shared backbone + regional heads architecture
Production API: serve predictions for upcoming tournament locations
